Q1: How far should the fix reach?
Choices:
A) Audit only: change `security-audit.yml` and `scripts/security_audit.sh`. Remove `GH_TOKEN`/`GH_PAT` from the model's environment during the Claude call, and make the reporting step check `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` against the verified support commit before running it. Fail closed if it doesn't match. The shared read-profile allowlist stays as it is.
B) Shared allowlist only: tighten `READ_PROFILE_ALLOW` / the read-profile settings in `scripts/claude_engine.py` so the allowed git commands refuse file-writing and command-running flags (`--output`, `-O`/`--open-files-in-pager`, `--ext-diff`, `--textconv`, and similar). Contract tests cover the change, and every read-profile role gets the fix.
C) A+B: harden the shared allowlist and add the audit-specific steps (no write-capable token in the model's environment, integrity check of the support script before the reporting step). (RECOMMENDED)
